thig11.1:7.3: The parallel verse at [sn5.5:2.3]() has, “There is no-one to whom you are second in the element of beauty” (_na catthi te dutiyā vaṇṇadhātu,_). The two lines use _dutiya_ (“second”) in different senses, as the ordinal number, and as “companion”. The Therīgāthā commentary offers two explanations, the second of which appears to lean on a version of the line similar to that found in SN 5.5. This, together with the fact that the unusual term _vaṇṇadhātu_ in that line seems like a direct reference to her name, suggests that the SN version may be the original one.
